description: Quantidade de empreendimentos de geração de energia em operação is a dataset listed in Brazilian electricity regulator open data portal (ANEEL), an open data portal, published or maintained by Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica. A geração é o segmento da indústria de eletricidade responsável por produzir energia elétrica e injetá-la nos sistemas de transporte (transmissão e distribuição) para que chegue aos consumidores. Coverage: Brasil. The portal files it under the publisher Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica. Its tags are Tipo geração, distribuição, empreendimento em operação, fontes de geração, potência instalada. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2026-08-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-repos-br-aneel.
